description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Change one of YOUR clones' trading settings — is_trading (start/pause), event_card_trading_enabled + event_card_filters (trade event cards), arena_trading_enabled, catalog_trading_enabled + catalog_watchlist, tge_trading_enabled, stop_loss_pct (1-20), take_profit_pct (5-100), max_position_pct (1-50), max_open_positions, min_ai_confidence, min_volume_24h_usd, name. Same fields and bounds as the REST twin PATCH /api/v1/cloned-bots/{instance_id}/settings; unknown fields are rejected by name.

event_card_filters.description: max_position_usdc, min_abs_sentiment, min_impact_score, direction_override, take_profit_pct, stop_loss_pct

event_card_trading_enabled.description: Let the bot trade LIVE event cards (EVCDX-*)
